intent: Remove the credential shape from the new-workload side with a clear revocation mark. The remaining workload boundary stays intact; access removal is narrower than deleting the workloads.
source:
**Frame:** A shared reader credential is removed from new research workloads. The credential shape is generic and contains no usable text.

**Action:** A capability that enabled the prior escalation is withdrawn.

**Caption:**
> THE SHARED READER CREDENTIAL IS REMOVED FROM NEW WORKLOADS.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-TR` §III.B and §X.
title: Shared reader credentials are removed
